rules.title: Groups by space
rules.rule: The gap between groups is at least 2x the gap within a group.

rules.title: Controls look like controls
rules.rule: Every interactive element has a shape, border, underline or consistent placement zone; a control never looks like static text.

rules.title: Shared edges
rules.rule: Content aligns to a small set of shared edges, with one spacing step per nesting level.

rules.title: Logical properties
rules.rule: Direction-dependent layout uses logical properties (margin-inline-start, text-align: start).

rules.title: RTL overrides
rules.rule: float uses inline-start; translateX and background-position on mirrored UI have a [dir=rtl] override.
rules.notes: Only when the app supports RTL.

rules.title: DOM order is visual order
rules.rule: Visual order matches DOM order; never reorder with order, row-reverse or grid placement.

rules.title: One primary, few secondaries
rules.rule: Each view has one primary action; more than 3 secondary actions go behind a menu.

rules.title: Hidden content has a cue
rules.rule: Off-screen or collapsed content has a visible cue: a peeking item, scroll affordance or disclosure.

rules.title: Truncation has a way back
rules.rule: Truncated text the user needs has a way to the full text (expand, detail view, keyboard-reachable tooltip); a hover-only title does not count.
rules.notes: Skill is stricter than issue 15 (any tooltip); skill wins.

rules.title: Disclosures name content
rules.rule: Disclosure controls name what is hidden ('Show 12 more results', not 'More').

rules.title: Control clearance
rules.rule: Leave about 12px between bordered or filled controls and about 24px between borderless text or icon controls, unless an established density says otherwise.

rules.title: No horizontal page scroll
rules.rule: At every supported desktop window width the page never scrolls horizontally (width: 100%, never 100vw).

rules.title: Container queries
rules.rule: Reusable components adapt with @container, not viewport @media.

rules.title: Container has a definite width
rules.rule: An element with container-type: inline-size has a definite width.

rules.title: Critical actions reachable
rules.rule: Critical actions never get clipped by resize, zoom or scroll; modals cap at the viewport height with actions outside the scroll area.

rules.title: Breakpoints from content
rules.rule: Breakpoints come from where the layout stops fitting, not device presets.

rules.title: Sizes from tokens
rules.rule: Font sizes, spacing, radii, shadows and fonts come from design-system tokens; no arbitrary values (w-[343px], p-[13px]).
rules.notes: Already gated by lint:apps (scan-literals). No design-score check id yet.

rules.title: Concentric radius
rules.rule: Nested rounded surfaces use outer radius = inner radius + padding (+ border width), up to a 24px inset.
rules.notes: DS has one 2px radius. Skip pairs where both radii are radius.base; check when either radius is above 4px.

rules.title: Concentric focus ring
rules.rule: An offset focus ring's radius equals the element radius plus the offset.

rules.title: Less padding on the icon side
rules.rule: A button with an icon and text takes 2-4px less padding on its icon side.
rules.notes: Skill says about 2px; issue 09 shows 4px. Both pass.

rules.title: Icon stroke matches text
rules.rule: An icon's rendered stroke tracks the adjacent text weight: 1.5px at 400, 2px at 500-600, 2.5px at 700.

rules.title: One icon library
rules.rule: Use one icon library per surface.

rules.title: Icon mirroring
rules.rule: Under dir=rtl mirror only icons whose meaning follows reading direction.
rules.notes: Only when the app supports RTL.

rules.title: Inline icon size
rules.rule: Inline icons are 1em-1.25em of the adjacent font size.

rules.title: SVG icons
rules.rule: Icons are SVG, never raster, on the grid that matches their render size.
rules.notes: Knowledge System's Better Creating icons are 96x96 PNG masks; each warns until they move to SVG or Ford accepts them.

rules.title: One way per detail
rules.rule: The same detail (radius, shadow, motion curve) is done one way across the project.

rules.title: cn for classes
rules.rule: Compose class names with a cn utility, not template literals.

rules.title: Tab label above indicator
rules.rule: Tab labels sit above the moving active indicator so it never covers them.

rules.title: Project idiom
rules.rule: Fixes use the project's own styling system and components (the design system), never a second one.

rules.title: Quantity
rules.rule: Repeating components handle zero, one, the realistic count and ten times it.

rules.title: Environment
rules.rule: Components hold in dark mode, browser zoom and reduced motion.

rules.title: No Figma URLs
rules.rule: No Figma asset URL remains in code.

rules.title: Self-contained SVG
rules.rule: SVG assets parse as XML with no duplicate IDs, unresolved url(#...) or external assets.

rules.title: No near-miss alignment
rules.rule: Related elements (a row's items, stacked labels and fields, a column of cards) share edges and centers exactly; an offset of 1-3px between them fails.
rules.notes: Offsets above 3px are treated as deliberate. Implied by shared edges and the 2px rounding threshold.

rules.title: Handles center on the first line
rules.rule: Drag handles, row icons, checkboxes, bullets and toggles beside text are vertically centered on the first line box of that text, not on the whole block.
rules.notes: Ford's docs-editor complaint: the block grab bar does not line up with the block text.

rules.title: Shared baselines
rules.rule: Text in one row (label and value, tabs, adjacent buttons, inline chips) shares one baseline.

rules.title: Icons centered in their box
rules.rule: An icon in an icon button or beside a label is centered in its box within 0.5px, on the label's cap-height middle, after optical correction for asymmetric glyphs.

rules.title: Equal control heights in a row
rules.rule: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls and control chips in one row have the same height.

rules.title: Control heights from a scale
rules.rule: Control heights across the app come from a small token set on the 4px grid (for example 24, 28, 32px).
rules.notes: No control-height tokens exist yet; see token proposals.

rules.title: Gaps on the 4px grid
rules.rule: Rendered gaps, padding and margins are values from the DS space scale (4px grid with 2px and 6px half steps).

rules.title: Same padding in repeated items
rules.rule: Repeated rows, cards, list and menu items of one kind have identical padding and inner gaps.

rules.title: One indent step
rules.rule: Nested tree and outline levels indent by one constant step per level.

rules.title: One icon size per role
rules.rule: Icons of one role on a surface (row icons, toolbar icons) render at one size.
